newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - BioChem estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - BioChem estimates raised.

text.p: Robertson Stephens & Co analyst Jay Silverman raised his earnings estimates for drug maker BioChem Pharma Inc based on what he called "spectacular" second quarter results.
-- raised his 1997 estimates to $0.58 per share from $0.52 and 1998 to $0.82 a share from $0.75.
-- said its AIDS drug 3TC continues to have a positive outlook. Rated stock a buy.
-- On Wednesday, the company reported second quarter earnings of $0.20 a share on a post-split basis versus $0.04 a share one year ago.
